verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents departmental budget controls and spend limits (jeeves-docs-6, jeeves-docs-20, jeeves-docs-23/44), and card controls that cap employee spend with custom limits, plus embedding expense policies into card programs. However, evidence is all first-party marketing copy without detail on program/department-level budget hierarchies, approval enforcement mechanics, or independent verification of how limits are enforced in practice. Missing for 10: technical/API documentation of budget-limit enforcement logic, evidence of department-level (vs individual card) budget rollups, and independent/hands-on confirmation that limits are actually enforced rather than just configurable.
